sources.fact: Public callers may receive LP tokens for protocol upkeep.

facts: update(address) returns a uint256 LP reward to its beneficiary; it may return zero during cooldown or revert when action is unavailable.
estimate_caller_profit() is an approximation. Zero alone does not prove the update has no reward.
pool, pegged, regulator, caller_share and last_change have public getters; action_delay does not.
The documented update transfers the calculated caller share of newly generated LP profit. A return value alone does not verify that transfer or cash value.
